toolsPreview.name: list_tools
toolsPreview.description: List all available Zero Core Tools with pricing and input requirements. Use this for discovery.

toolsPreview.name: health
toolsPreview.description: Check Zero Core Tools server status, uptime, and payment network configuration.

toolsPreview.name: scrape_url
toolsPreview.description: Scrape any URL and return cleaned text content. Powered by Playwright headless browser. Returns title, content, word count.

toolsPreview.name: screenshot_url
toolsPreview.description: Take a full-page screenshot of any URL. Returns base64-encoded PNG image.

toolsPreview.name: extract_structured_data
toolsPreview.description: Scrape a URL then use AI to extract structured JSON data matching your schema description. Combines Playwright scraping with Grok LLM extraction.

toolsPreview.name: review_code
toolsPreview.description: AI-powered security and quality code review. Analyzes for vulnerabilities, anti-patterns, performance issues, and best practices. Returns issues with severity, suggestions, and an overall score.

toolsPreview.name: generate_content
toolsPreview.description: Generate high-quality written content. Supports blog posts, product descriptions, documentation, social posts, and emails. Customizable tone, length, and keywords.

toolsPreview.name: analyze_sentiment
toolsPreview.description: Analyze sentiment of text with entity extraction, confidence scores, and key phrase identification. Returns positive/negative/neutral/mixed with detailed breakdown.

toolsPreview.name: search_web
toolsPreview.description: Search the web via Google and return organic results with titles, links, and snippets. Optionally returns answer box if available.
